prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1068; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the injured party in connection with the side-impact collision that occurred at a controlled intersection and resulted in significant bodily injury to our client. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter, including requests for statements, scheduling, and settlement discussions, exclusively to this office and do not contact our client directly.

We request that you disclose the bodily injury liability limits of the policy issued to your insured, together with a certified copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please provide this information within the time frame permitted under applicable law.

Your insured and your company are hereby placed on notice of a duty to preserve all evidence relevant to this loss. This includes photographs, dash camera and telematics data, vehicle event data recorder information, the damaged vehicle itself until it has been inspected, adjuster notes, recorded statements, and all claim file materials. Destruction or alteration of any such evidence may result in sanctions. We look forward to your prompt written acknowledgment of this letter.
